*APPS YOU NEED*

Everyone should have these platforms:

1️⃣ METATRADER 5 (MT5)

This is where we will practice opening and managing trades.

You can use it to:

• Open BUY/SELL trades
• Set Stop Loss
• Set Take Profit
• View charts
• Manage a demo account
• Monitor your positions

📱 Android → Download MetaTrader 5 from Google Play.

🍎 iPhone → Download MetaTrader 5 from the App Store.

Official MT5:
https://www.metatrader5.com/en/mobile-trading

2️⃣ TRADINGVIEW

TradingView will be used mainly for chart viewing and market analysis.

You can use it to:

• Study price charts
• Change timeframes
• Add indicators
• Draw on charts
• Mark important price levels
• Analyze the market

📱 Android → TradingView app

🍎 iPhone → TradingView app

🌐 You can also use TradingView from your browser.

Official TradingView:
https://www.tradingview.com/mobile/

3️⃣ FBS

FBS will be useful for our practical/demo training.

📱 Android → You can download the FBS app.

🍎 iPhone → Use the FBS website/app where available.

🌐 iPhone users can also access FBS through the browser/WebTrader.

Official FBS:
https://fbs.com/

⚠️ VERY IMPORTANT

DO NOT DEPOSIT REAL MONEY YET.

For now, we are going to work with a DEMO ACCOUNT.

The purpose is to learn how to use the platform, place trades, set SL/TP and manage positions without risking real money.

I will guide you step by step.

📌 IF YOU HAVE INSTALLED THEM:

Send a screenshot in the group showing that you have:

✅ MetaTrader 5
✅ TradingView
✅ FBS

Then we'll begin the practical part.
